name: Xiaoyuan 14B
description: A local-first, safety-gated agent network around a quantized 14B open-weight model. Published as a portable, data-only agent network for the Open Agentic Web Challenge.

networks.name: xiaoyuan_14b
networks.description: Safety-gated local agent with a deterministic front door, a safety gate, and a grounded project-facts action.

default.note: The public demo answers from a deterministic local policy so it runs without a key. No model inference is claimed for this path.

byok.note: A visitor may enter their own OpenAI-compatible router base URL, model, and key. The key stays in browser-local storage and is sent only to that router.

x-site-actions.name: get_project_facts
x-site-actions.description: Returns grounded facts about the Xiaoyuan 14B project, including what it is, what it is not, and its local evidence boundaries.
